title: Existing retirement and deferred compensation plans.
bodyText: This chapter shall not affect any existing retirement or deferred compensation plans established under section 457 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, or chapter 88E.
bodyHtml: [§88F-13]  Existing retirement and deferred compensation plans.  This chapter shall not affect any existing retirement or deferred compensation plans established under section 457 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, or chapter 88E. [L 1996, c 212, pt of §2]
